principle: Producer qualification asks whether the producer is SOUND and fail-closed. No gate depends on the sign or size of any R''' value; there is no sign threshold for PASS. No gate is evaluated on a real CUSUM cell.
evidence: config/QUALIFICATION_PROTOCOL.json parts, assembled by code/qualify_order3.py assemble()

gates.G01_input_identity: K1 record validation (part k1) passes V01-V10 on the committed copies of cells 0 and 309, and the wrong-manifest and wrong-cell controls are refused (FC03, FC04).
gates.G02_producer_identity: config/ORDER3_PRODUCER_MANIFEST.json verifies byte-for-byte from disk in the qualification process, and every part ran under the frozen protocol sha256.
gates.G03_exact_derivative_order_3: (a) the Arb engine reproduces the frozen reference kernel's F_r:3 midpoint and cascade and W:3 cascade and Taylor values exactly up to outward rounding (QR); (b) every manufactured fixture's export contains the EXACT third derivative (QS); (c) exact-candidate residuals of the order-3 equation vanish to the consistency threshold (QC).
gates.G04_finite_interval: every fixture export is finite (no refusal on valid inputs), and non-finite inputs (inf enclosure, NaN candidate) are refused (FC07, FC07b).
gates.G05_lo_le_hi: L <= U for every exported interval.
gates.G06_signed_interval_semantics: the fixture set produces CERTIFIED_POSITIVE, CERTIFIED_NEGATIVE and SIGN_INDETERMINATE exports, all containing exact truth; the export-uses-midpoint-radius mutation (M15) is detected.
gates.G07_whole_cell_soundness: zero containment violations at e0 and at 17 exact grid points per fixture (QS), and every whole-cell mutation (M05, M06, M09, M11, M16) is detected. The proof is DESIGN_REAL.md section 4; samples are necessary conditions only.
gates.G08_no_unsigned_magnitude_substitution: producer modules contain no mag_fraction / abs-of-centre export (static scan) and CERTIFIED_NEGATIVE exports occur.
gates.G09_no_finite_difference_substitution: producer modules contain no evaluation of truth / expansion / finite-difference tokens (static scan); R''' comes only from the order-3 equation.
gates.G10_precision_escalation_consistency: overall precision label is not UNSTABLE: no sign flip and no disjoint intervals across 128/192/256/384/512 bits.
gates.G11_deterministic_scientific_serializati: two fresh-process determinism parts and the soundness part give identical canonical scientific payload hashes per fixture.
gates.G12_deterministic_scientific_hash: the two fresh-process determinism parts agree and no hash is missing.
gates.G13_runtime_dependency_identity: every part records python 3.12.3, python-flint 0.9.0, numpy 2.5.2, host rebaseguard-vultr-02, prefix /root/work/rbg-cusum-aux5-venv, x86_64.
gates.G14_fail_closed: every fail-closed control (FC01-FC13) and every real-cell gate control (no / forged authorization, gate before record validation, empty registry, manifest verifies, subclass surface) passes.
gates.G15_k1_record_provenance: committed K1 record copies of cells 0 and 309 validate against export manifest 29ad1f9b and producer identity 3692d0fe, with target_gate PASS for every m (cell 309 is in the endpoint region).
gates.G16_no_scientific_probe_contamination: no part other than operator/realgate loads CUSUM certifier modules; the operator and realgate parts record zero calls to collocation / prepare / residual / propagation / engine / validate functions in repository code; static import fences hold; no module attribute assignment (Aux3 no_monkeypatch detector, which fires on its control).

verdict_rule.REAL_ORDER3_PRODUCER: QUALIFIED requires all G01-G16 PASS, QS/QC/QM/QR/QX/QO PASS, a frozen governance protocol, any permitted real qualification passed, and no remaining blocker to scientific probe authorization. PARTIALLY_QUALIFIED if the gates and questions pass but a stated blocker remains. NOT_READY if any soundness gate (G03, G04, G05, G06, G07, G14) fails. INFEASIBLE only with a proof that no sound signed whole-cell enclosure is constructible.
declared_blockers_known_before_results: REAL_CELL_QUALIFICATION = NOT_AUTHORIZED: the real CUSUM end-to-end path (Order3Certifier.prepare, collect_inputs, cross_check_k1) is not executed, and L4 host determinism on real cells is not measured.

Cell-0 width forecast (DESIGN_REAL.md section 6), computed from committed K1 magnitudes only: the frozen midpoint rule forces a certified R''' radius >= C*3*k1*eps_H,mid ~ 2.7e7 at CUSUM cell 0, so the H3a sign test there is expected SIGN_INDETERMINATE, which the frozen oracle's Q2 rule turns into STOP.
